title: マイルCSの後に・風はここから

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr runs with all her might and feels as though she truly became the wind during the race. But at the same time, she feels that she still has room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After catching sight of a banner in the stands that reads "Zephyr Spirit," she vows to embrace the support of her fans and become an even greater wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her winning concert, Zephyr talks about how her journey started here at Kyoto Racecourse, where she first saw the Mile Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She requests that our next goal be the Yasuda Kinen, a mile race. The chapter in which she surpasses the Mile Emperor to become a triple-distance champion starts now.
